''See also: [[Silverfang Carp Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Silverfang Carp are large aquatic creatures that possess significant power and can swim through the air. They were raised in their habitat similarly to livestock, serving as a food source for larger [[Ghostwater]] specimens, such as [[Diamondscale Sea Drakes]]. While the fish can be consumed by humans, their meat is extremely dangerous; eating it can cause severe physical harm, including organ failure, seizures, and paralyzing pain. Despite these risks, the meat is potent enough to provide strength and lightness to those who digest it. In combat, these fish can move in large schools, creating a hazy environment that resembles swimming through smoke.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|The Silverfang Carp are schooling fish that were raised like cattle to serve as food for larger [[Ghostwater]] specimens. Although they are not intended for human consumption, their meat is known to promote muscle growth and physical vitality. As the fish approached the habitat, [[Lindon]] and [[Orthos]] managed to finish a specimen nearly a week prior by killing it with a [[Remnant]] fist. Ultimately, the meat from the Silverfang Carp served to nourish [[Lindon's body]].}}
